jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(I) inventory: Craftsbury School District, a town school district in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Craftsbury).
Craftsbury Town School District (official district website).

sources.note: Craftsbury School Board roster sheet (district's own, linked from the Orleans Southwest SU board page): five directors -- Kasey Allen (Chair, 2-year seat, term end 2027), Cedar Hannan (Vice Chair, 3-year, 2029), Isaac Jacobs (3-year, 2027), Michelle Menard (Clerk, 2-year, 2028), Anna Schulz (3-year, 2028) -- the section 423(a)-(b) shape (three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats), elected at-large. The same five are present in the September 9 and October 14, 2026 board minutes, and the superintendent's April 2026 newsletter states 'everyone returned' at the March 3, 2026 election. (The town report's officers table once prints 'Cedrus Hannan' -- a typo; district sources uniformly read Cedar Hannan.)
